headline_marked: [[BNP leader's body recovered]] from Kaptai Lake two days after going missing
headline: BNP leader's body recovered from Kaptai Lake two days after going missing
summary: Md Masud, a local BNP leader, was found floating in Kaptai Lake in Rangamati yesterday. He had been missing since Saturday after his boat was discovered loaded with goods.
details: The body of Md Masud, 50, president of BNP's ward 6 unit in Kaptai union, was recovered from Kaptai Lake in Rangamati yesterday. He had been missing for two days after travelling by boat.

Masud's body was found floating in the Garjontila area of the lake around 11:00am, the same location where he was believed to have drowned on Saturday. Police rushed to the scene to retrieve the body, and legal proceedings are now underway.
A seasonal fruit trader, Masud had left Kaptai for Bilaichhari on July 16, carrying fruits. He regularly made this trip, usually returning home by Friday afternoon or Saturday morning.
When he failed to return by Saturday morning, his family initiated a search. Later that afternoon, locals found his boat, still loaded with goods, in the Garjontila area of Kaptai Lake.

Following the discovery of his boat, the navy was informed, and a diving team launched a search operation on Saturday evening. This operation was suspended around 11:00pm after failing to locate him, but fire service and navy diving teams resumed efforts over the subsequent two days.
